title: Allow smoother Panel thumbnail popup animation
line: Task Manager tooltips now fade in when you move between tasks, and window thumbnails fade in instead of popping in.
explanation: When the pointer moved from one task to another, the shared tooltip window swapped its contents in a single frame (KWin no longer has the morphing popups effect that used to smooth this), and the window thumbnail appeared a few hundred milliseconds later, popping into an empty box. The tooltip delegate now fades its content in whenever it is placed into an already visible tooltip window, and the PipeWire thumbnail (with its drop shadow) fades in once its stream is ready. Both use Kirigami.Units.longDuration, so they follow the global animation speed and are instant when animations are off.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: fade tooltip content and thumbnails in

Moving the pointer between tasks swapped the tooltip contents at once,
and the window thumbnail popped in a moment later. The tooltip content
now fades in when it moves to another task, and so does the thumbnail.

BUG: 507564

patches.diff:
From 7a3a5c905a46a26f8c3bb684d6c485575ae7c12d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:17:25 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: fade tooltip content and thumbnails in

Moving the pointer between tasks swapped the tooltip contents at once,
and the window thumbnail popped in a moment later. The tooltip content
now fades in when it moves to another task, and so does the thumbnail.

BUG: 507564
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/PipeWireThumbnail.qml |  6 ++++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml   | 14 ++++++++++++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipInstance.qml   |  1 +
 3 files changed, 21 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/PipeWireThumbnail.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/PipeWireThumbnail.qml
index 9209ab581d..699d72e6f5 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/PipeWireThumbnail.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/PipeWireThumbnail.qml
@@ -5,6 +5,7 @@
 */
 
 import QtQuick
+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 import org.kde.pipewire as PipeWire
 import org.kde.taskmanager as TaskManager
 
@@ -16,6 +17,11 @@ PipeWire.PipeWireSourceItem {
     anchors.fill: parent
     nodeId: waylandItem.nodeId
 
+    opacity: ready ? 1 : 0
+    Behavior on opacity {
+        NumberAnimation { duration: Kirigami.Units.longDuration }
+    }
+
     TaskManager.ScreencastingRequest {
         id: waylandItem
         uuid: thumbnailSourceItem.winId
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml
index 014e954c5c..43715d41f8 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipDelegate.qml
@@ -67,6 +67,20 @@ Loader {
 
     sourceComponent: isGroup ? groupToolTip : singleTooltip
 
+    Window.onWindowChanged: {
+        if (Window.window?.visible) {
+            contentFadeIn.restart();
+        }
+    }
+
+    OpacityAnimator {
+        id: contentFadeIn
+        target: toolTipDelegate
+        from: 0
+        to: 1
+        duration: Kirigami.Units.longDuration
+    }
+
     Component {
         id: singleTooltip
 
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipInstance.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipInstance.qml
index 5a42d24a17..64ddb04e3a 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipInstance.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ToolTipInstance.qml
@@ -326,6 +326,7 @@ ColumnLayout {
                 && ((pipeWireLoader.item as PipeWireThumbnail)?.hasThumbnail ?? false)
             asynchronous: true
             visible: active
+            opacity: pipeWireLoader.item?.opacity ?? 1
             anchors.fill: pipeWireLoader
 
             sourceComponent: GE.DropShadow {
--
